EXACTLY two detached gnarled root-knuckle hands (rounded wooden blobs, no fingers) floating clear at each side and two detached splayed root-cluster feet below, all with flat-green gaps; charcoal spot-black knots, a lone muted-red bloom on the shoulder, flat cel shadow bands on the bark. Palette: olive #6E7042 bark, charcoal #22252B knots, tan #C49A5A fibres, muted-red #9E3B36 thorns and bloom, plasma-lime #9CFF3B eye. Palette: Olive #6E7042 bark-body, charcoal #22252B knots and shadow, tan #C49A5A dry-stalk fibres, muted-red #9E3B36 thorn-tips and a single bloom, plasma-lime #9CFF3B new-growth eye..
